title: marketPartner
description: Market partner responsible for the balancing group, including the partner's validity period.

marketPartnerCode.description: 13-digit identifier of the responsible market partner.

marketPartnerName.description: Name of the responsible market partner.

marketPartnerFrom.description: UTC timestamp marking the beginning of the market partner's validity period.

marketPartnerTo.description: UTC timestamp marking the end of the market partner's validity period.
